body:
>         And I find his entire rant against leftists -- fully
> one-third of his manifesto -- to be unnecessary to his
> anti-technology argument.   He doesn't want any
> liberals to participate in his hoped-for revolution.

Ummm,,,,this is a common misconception, but it's not true that 1/3 of
the manifesto is devoted to the anti leftist rant. Here's the breakdown:
Para.6-32 deal with leftists, and it is not at all a blanket
condemnation of ALL leftists, because at (23) he qualifies his argument
with this line: "this is only a rough indication of a general tendency
of leftism".
>From there he goes on to the subject of autonomy, which he says is a
basic need that has been denied in our society. This seems like a
tangent till we get to the main point, which is how people are
psychologically damaged by the technocratic society.

Only at the end (213-230) does Ted get back onto the leftists. This
leaves a total of 43 leftist-oriented paragraphs, with a total of 188
non-leftist paragraphs. LEt's see, that's approx. 2/9ths or maybe .2 or
maybe .15 or something that a mathematician like Ted can tell us. Now I
don't usually get this picky when analyzing the Manifesto, but I'm just
getting tired of that mindless bromide "1/3 of the manifesto is a
leftist rant", which is another bit of boilerplate prose like the
epithet "RAMBLING".

> So he certainly screwed himself as a revolutionary in
> terms of tactics, as leftists are the ones who tend
> to be more environmentally aware.

This is true, but if one reads it closely one realizes that Ted is
talking about the Stalinist-type leftist who extolls Progress &
behavioral engineering & has made Russia one of the most polluted
nations on earth. And once again, in 228., Ted qualifies his argument by
saying that "some individuals meet some of the criteria ... you will
just have to use your own judgment." This is pretty reasonable-sounding,
coming from someone everyone thinks of as a schizo, a maniac, etc. If
the author hadn't been a bomb-maker, I would just think of him as a
plain old college professor having an afternoon bull session w/ his
students!
